data.desc: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:CRDL) (TSX:CRDL) is a clinical-stage life sciences company focused on developing therapies targeting inflammation and fibrosis associated with heart disease. The company's lead investigational drug candidate, CardiolRx, is being evaluated in the pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial for recurrent pericarditis. Cardiol is also advancing its ARCHER program in myocarditis.
